paige_legal: Customer legal sent a formal ask: retain raw audit logs for 7 years under a BYOK model. They want a contract clause. Need product/security to outline guardrails and acceptance criteria ASAP.
ashley_product: I can write the acceptance checklist. Couple quick checks: do they want us to keep keys in our KMS (CMEK) or to provide encrypted exports to their bucket?
liam_security: They said keys on their HSM. Two feasible patterns: (A) Redwood retains encrypted logs but never has plaintext keys (per-tenant key pulling + attestation). (B) Redwood runs monthly encrypted snapshots to customer-controlled storage. Pattern A keeps data in our system longer; B shifts custody.
sam_engineering: Implementation implications: A needs per-tenant KMS plugin, rotation protocol, and key attestation verification at write time. B needs reliable export pipeline, signed manifests, and delivery receipts. Both need TTL flags and must respect legal_hold toggles.
jordan_sre: For long retention we need: snapshot cadence, integrity proofs (hash chain or signed manifest), and documented RTO/RPO for restores. Also runbook for legal_hold tests.
paige_legal: From contract side we need: residency statement, custody language (we never have plaintext if BYOK), termination/export steps, evidence format, chain-of-custody, and limits on liability. Also clarify e-discovery cost responsibilities.
ashley_product: Draft acceptance criteria (working draft):
- retention_bucket = "legal_extended" TTL = 7 years
- key_model = "BYOK_customer_hsm" or "monthly_export_to_customer"
- delivery = monthly encrypted snapshot + manifest (SHA256 checksums, signed)
- evidence_retention = signed manifest + delivery receipt stored 10 years
- legal_hold = boolean toggle that suspends TTL expiry immediately
- export_sla = monthly export completes within 72h of month boundary; retry/backoff documented
- restore_capability = documented restore window and verification steps
- attestation = customers provide key attestation token; Redwood verifies on ingest
liam_security: Additions: require envelope encryption with customer KEK for exports, require attestation expiration policy, and logging that proves Redwood never had KEK plaintext. We'll stub attestation example.
sam_engineering: Rough effort estimate: export-first approach is ~0.4-0.8 FTE infra work + storage/egress costs; in-system BYOK retention is ~1.0-1.8 FTE plus more for key lifecycle and audit controls. Indexing for retained logs should be optional (indexless archive) to reduce cost.
paige_legal: Legal needs final acceptance text by Wed EOD to draft contract language. If product/security prefer export-first we can present that as default and escalate if customer insists.
jordan_sre: Runbook skeleton to include:
- API/CLI command to toggle legal_hold
- manual export trigger flow and verification steps
- checksum verification & manifest validation
- oncall escalation for export failures and missed SLA
opsbot: Reference doc created: https://tiny.redwood/longterm-retention-byo-draft 
ashley_product: Risk note: retaining long-term logs increases SOC2/ISO scope; prefer export-then-offload when possible. If customer requires in-house retention, require security addendum and extra audit cycles.
liam_security: For ISO controls: monthly attestations, signed delivery receipts, and retention evidence in our control mapping. We should also require customer to confirm KMS attestation method (e.g., PKCS#11 attestation blob).
paige_legal: Customer Qs we should answer before next call: 1) Who is liable if an export is tampered? 2) Who pays for e-discovery and long-term storage costs? 3) Can legal_hold be initiated by customer?
sam_engineering: Proposal: default to export-to-customer model; customer pays incremental storage/transfer. For in-house retention, require a security addendum + cost pass-through for audit evidence.
ashley_product: Action items:
- ashley_product + liam_security: finalize acceptance checklist PR to /docs/retention-exemptions by Wed EOD (owner: ashley_product)
- paige_legal: produce contract draft w/ custody & termination language by Fri
- sam_engineering: deliver scoped implementation estimate + cost model by next Tue
- jordan_sre: publish runbook skeleton by next Tue
- schedule 30m sync w/ customer Thu 10:30am PT (I'll send invite)
paige_legal: tagging @customer-success for handoff once draft exists. :white_check_mark:
liam_security: I'll attach an example attestation token and an envelope-encryption sample to the PR.
ashley_product: I'll open an RFC and link it in the PR: https://tiny.redwood/rfc/longterm-retention-byo (please review)
paige_legal: Thanks team. Keep updates brief in this thread; legal will proceed once acceptance criteria approved.
